p: You also mentioned earlier in your testimony that there-- that the NYPD can view the footage. Does someone from the NYPD watch the video feed from NYCHA cameras on a 24/7 basis?

So, initially when-for the NYPD we had what was called the Viper Rooms and we would have officers sitting in the Viper Room watching those videos 24/7. With the integrations that we have, it’s on an as-needed purpose-- basis that we would log in and view the cameras.
